items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the sheaf of maps out of the sheaf represented by an object with the pushforward of the restriction of the given sheaf to the localized site (statement lines 6005-6010). The proof is a complete computation by representable functors: for an arbitrary sheaf the author rewrites the morphism sets through the restriction, the adjunction with the lower shriek, the identification of that lower shriek with a product and the adjunction between the product and the sheaf of maps (proof lines 6015-6027), concluding by the Yoneda lemma (proof lines 6028-6030). The non-formal content is the chain of identifications. The claim is H1: a written-out computation with each input named.
